name: Alisa Dvachevskaya Vikentiyevna
source:
Born April 3rd, 1971 in the city of Moscow. 

Except for an almost pathological search for "the next high", nothing notable was discovered in her biography. 

Official cause of death: 

Falling from a great height and subsequent death form an accident. 

Her case was reviewed many times over, since there was high reason to believe her death was not an accident. 

[Based on the in-game profile]
